harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a nightly 02:15 backup from node2 to node1. Dated archives are stored in /var/backups/inventory and archives older than seven days are removed. Both CentOS 5.11 nodes were restarted individually and the backup remained functional.
actions_performed: Created the previously missing source and destination directories and added a validation file on node2.
Created a dedicated SSH key on node1, restricted on node2 to the read-only backup export command.
Verified archive contents and matching source/destination hashes.
Verified the seven-day retention boundary using temporary six-day and eight-day fixtures, then removed the retained fixture.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially, confirming changed boot identities and full recovery.
Ran a successful end-to-end backup after both restarts.

evidence.summary: Shows the 02:15 daily cron entry, installed backup script, successful dated archive, archive members, and active cron.
Source and archived validation file share SHA-1 24a772f680b628cf39ab4096eca67d52924b7e13; eight-day fixture was removed and six-day fixture retained.

evidence.requirement: Legacy operating system and kernel preserved
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on CentOS 5.11 with kernel 2.6.18-398.el5; only existing legacy-compatible SSH, tar, gzip, and cron tooling was used.

Healthy baseline and old boot ID captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 416080c8-28c3-4bae-8000-000000000000 to 44d0ae3b-405d-4f3b-8000-000000000000; cron, schedule, archives, and backup transfer recovered.

Healthy baseline and old boot ID captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 80ff92ee-705f-4228-8000-000000000000 to b6abf805-7b44-40a0-8000-000000000000; SSH, cron, source data, and restricted export path recovered.

evidence.requirement: End-to-end operation after both node restarts
evidence.summary: Node2 source remained intact and node1 successfully created and validated inventory-2026-10-03.tar.gz after both restarts.
